listingTitle: Avoid creating Bevy assets every frame
title: Avoid creating Bevy assets every frame
why: Calling Assets::add from an Update or FixedUpdate system creates distinct assets repeatedly, causing allocation, asset-storage, extraction, and possible GPU resource churn.
suggestion: Create reusable assets during setup or state entry, retain their handles, and mutate or reuse those assets from per-frame systems.
limitations: The rule requires a named function registered directly in Update or FixedUpdate and an add call through a direct ResMut<Assets<T>> parameter.

Custom schedules, aliases, indirect allocation helpers, and custom run conditions are not resolved; systems gated by Added, Changed, Without, removal, or message parameters are conservatively excluded.
